definitions.explanation: Tasks or matters that need to be attended to. Things one needs to take care of.

examples.japanese: {用事|ようじ}があるので、{先|さき}に{帰|かえ}ります。
examples.english: I have errands to run, so I'm leaving first.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{用事|ようじ}がありますか。
examples.english: Do you have anything to do today?

examples.japanese: {用事|ようじ}で{出|で}かけます。

notes: Very useful for explaining why you can't do something or need to leave. {用事|ようじ}がある is a polite way to decline without giving specific details. Different from {仕事|しごと} (work/job) - {用事|ようじ} is more general.
